name: Primitive relaunch 2026: Agent Swarm control in cyberspace (navy identity)
source: Built around the official logo (rsc/brand/primitive-logo.png, vectorized to primitive-logo.svg). The navy #000050 is sampled exactly from the logo. Cyan #00D2FD (the original logo circles) and the agent magenta are secondary accents only.

navy.use: primary brand color: logo, headlines, primary buttons, dark sections

navy-hi.use: hover on navy, raised cards on navy

periwinkle.use: headline emphasis and links on white

lavender.use: secondary text and emphasis on navy

on-navy.use: text and reversed logo on navy

cyan.use: secondary accent: grid, glow, live dots, on navy only (never text on white)

signal.use: secondary accent: agents only, small marks

font.display: Quicksand (self-hosted variable woff2, SIL OFL), weight 300, tracking 0.01em; the closest thin, rounded geometric match to the wordmark
font.label: Quicksand 600, uppercase, 11-12px, tracking 0.28em: wordmark-style eyebrows and tags
font.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Cascadia Code", Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace: commands only

logo.clearspace: at least the height of one logo circle on every side

voice: Lead with: Primitive is back. Agent Swarm control in cyberspace.
Short, declarative, second person. Name real things (Claude Code, Codex, OpenXR, islands, traces).
Describe only what the product READMEs state; mark illustrations as concepts; no invented stats or quotes.
